text: 128 BPM. Brightness dark. Introspective night drive atmosphere. deep_house / ambient track. C minor. 4/4 time. intro: low density, sub bass only; role=establish loneliness. verse: sparse drums, short phrases, clear rests; role=restrained movement. chorus: full energy, wide stereo, focused layers; role=emotional release. bridge: no kick, no bass, minimal texture; role=near silence and reflection. Avoid: bright festival EDM; comic vocal delivery. Wide stereo. Active rate 0.90-0.93. Valley depth 0.15-0.25.
advisories: Suno は dark 指定で絶対 dark 帯（centroid ≤1200Hz）に到達した実績なし（K2: 0/4）。暗さが要件なら生成後の centroid 確認を推奨。
